AUTHOR: Gallitto
TITLE: Automatic Extraction and Counting of Fish from Underwater Videos Using YOLO-Based Deep Learning Algorithms
REGION: Tavolara - Punta Coda Cavallo MPA (Isola Rossa), Sardinia, Italy; other Sardinian sites surveyed
SPECIES: 28 Mediterranean fish classes incl. 'Afish poly' unidentified class (e.g. Oblada melanura, Chromis chromis, Coris julis, Diplodus spp., Spicara smaris)
DATA: Own SardinIA dataset (729 annotated frames) from diver-operated video transects (Aug 2024, 15 m, 3 replicate 50-m transects); off-the-shelf DeepFins and DeepEcomar models also applied
V_EV: 2.1 Data acquisition: 'during August 2024 by scuba operators, at 15 m depth.'
D2: YOLOE: random 8:1:1 train/validation/test of 729 labelled frames; YOLOv8 split not reported
D_EV: 2.4.2: 'The labelled fish dataset used for YOLOE experiments is randomly divided into training, validation and testing sets in the ratio of 8:1:1.'
R_EV: 2.2: 'This dataset, called SardinIA, was also used as ground truth for evaluating all the obtained results.'
C_EV: 2.4.2: 'Under evaluation conditions with IoU = 0.5 and confidence threshold (conf) = 0.4'; DeepSort chosen for 'effectively reducing identity-switching issues encountered with other algorithms'
E_EV: 3, Table 2: 'The DeepSort-based automated method achieved a total fish count (261) almost identical to DOVC (260), indicating strong reliability in overall abundance estimation.'
ARCH: YOLOE (text-prompt RRTA transfer learning) and custom YOLOv8 detectors; DeepFins (YOLOv11) and DeepEcomar (YOLOv5m) off-the-shelf; DeepSort / ByteTrack / SAMURAI trackers
METR: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1 (IoU 0.5, conf 0.4); per-species and total counts vs UVC and DOVC (Table 2)
NOTE: E: automated counts compared with UVC (diver in-situ census, independent reference) and DOVC (human reading of diver video, likely the same footage); E5 coded independent because UVC is included; comparison is descriptive only (Table 2, no statistics). R: off-the-shelf DeepFins (Australian-trained; F1 90.0% on OzFish cited) and DeepEcomar were applied to Sardinian frames with much lower scores, which a verifier could treat as an external test (R1 = Y, R2 = 복수, R3 = Y); coded N because the proposed models are evaluated only on a random split of the single SardinIA dataset. C4 = Y because an 'Afish poly' class is implemented 'to group unrecognized or ambiguous elements'. C5 = ID-switch handling based on the explicit DeepSort choice for reducing identity switches; ID switches were not quantified - if a verifier requires quantification, C5 = 없음 and C_ALL = P. V: only depth reported (5/15 m), no visibility/turbidity mention for own data. ENV: Mediterranean MPA with Posidonia meadows, coded temperate rocky; could be 혼합. Unclear whether test frames come from the same videos as the counting transects.
